visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: All Rows of the Grid Are the Same List
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Setting the first cell of the grid to 1 should change only the first row, but all three rows change.

solution.code:
grid = [[0] * 3 for _ in range(3)]
grid[0][0] = 1
print(grid)
solution.explanation: [row] * 3 repeats a reference to the same row list three times, so a change through one row shows up in all of them. A comprehension creates a new list for every row.
